#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Finite Records-fold experiment in Alpha's canonical, released queue slot.

Use the stable compiler paths, back up each replaced file, restore in finally.
Both cohorts invoke the unchanged registered wasm-tier benchmark entry point.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRIVATE = ROOT / 'backup/records-bounds-alpha'
PREFIX = 'records-bounds-alpha-2026-11-16'
EXPECTED_HEAD = '6a066abd'
EXPECTED_C = '68d3c5a5372d2b97ca22812cf3d9d360d0c0a6979a62bdf6c570aacd5cd29f41'
EXPECTED_HEADER = '671d4ea3cf103243d549c88f636cf5f35bf5c08648fd49a9e9829e1d2d997d40'
REPLACED = ['build/compiler-assembly/compiler_zir_lower.c',
            'build/obj/assembly/compiler_zir_lower.o', 'build/obj/assembly-core.o',
            'build/bin/zi2zx', 'build/bin/zx2native']
TOOLS = ['build/bin/ziran', 'build/bin/zi2c', 'build/bin/zi2zx',
         'build/bin/zx2native', 'build/bin/zx2wasm', 'build/libziran.a']
HARNESSES = ['bench/bench.zi', 'bench/wasm_tier.py', 'bench/wasm_tier.zi',
             'bench/site_target_host.c', 'bench/site_target_backend.h',
             'scripts/site_target_node.cjs', 'scripts/site_target_platforms.py',
             'scripts/site_targets.py']


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def hashes(names):
    return {str(name): sha(ROOT / name) for name in names}


def tree_hashes(names):
    return hashes(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for name in names
                  for p in sorted((ROOT / name).rglob('*')) if p.is_file())


def output(args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True).strip()


def main():
    os.chdir(ROOT)
    assert platform.node().split('.')[0].lower() == 'alpha', 'physical Alpha required'
    virtual = subprocess.run(['systemd-detect-virt'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert virtual.returncode == 1 and virtual.stdout.strip() == 'none', 'virtual host refused'
    assert output(['git', 'branch', '--show-current']) == 'master'
    head = output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
    assert head.startswith(EXPECTED_HEAD), 'Alpha baseline changed; revise experiment before running'
    assert PRIVATE.is_dir()
    assert subprocess.run(['git', 'check-ignore', '-q', str(PRIVATE)]).returncode == 0
    assert sha(PRIVATE / 'compiler_zir_lower.c') == EXPECTED_C
    assert sha(ROOT / 'build/compiler-assembly/compiler_zir_lower.h') == EXPECTED_HEADER
    receipts = {arm: ROOT / 'bench/results' / (PREFIX + '-' + arm + '.json')
                for arm in ('before', 'after')}
    assert not any(p.exists() for p in receipts.values()), 'refuse to overwrite a prior cohort'
    assert not (PRIVATE / 'state.json').exists(), 'inspect the prior attempt before retrying'
    index = ROOT / output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--git-path', 'index'])
    index_before = sha(index)
    shutil.copy2(index, PRIVATE / 'source.index')
    os.environ['GIT_INDEX_FILE'] = str(PRIVATE / 'source.index')
    os.environ['ZIRAN_LEARN'] = 'off'
    os.environ.pop('DISPLAY', None)
    os.environ.pop('WAYLAND_DISPLAY', None)
    tracked = output(['git', 'ls-files', '--', 'cmd', 'std', 'include', 'bootstrap',
                      'Makefile', 'assembly.mk']).splitlines()
    assert not output(['git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--name-only', '--', 'cmd', 'std',
                       'include', 'bootstrap', 'Makefile', 'assembly.mk']), 'compiler sources dirty'
    assert not output(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--',
                       'cmd', 'std', 'include', 'bootstrap']), 'untracked compiler source'
    guards = {'source': hashes(tracked), 'harness': hashes(HARNESSES),
              'standard': tree_hashes(['bench/standard', 'build/standard', 'bench/results/standard']),
              'objects': tree_hashes(['build/obj/assembly']), 'tools': hashes(TOOLS)}
    state = {'head': head, 'host': platform.node(), 'virtualization': 'none',
             'learning': 'off', 'started_ns': time.time_ns(), 'commands': [],
             'guards_before': guards, 'epochs': {}, 'stage': 'prepared',
             'source_lower_sha256': '2f2c96735a670a61ad3695de1d23de4a89e828bf2c24952bbea031e1638da2b1',
             'generated_lower_sha256': EXPECTED_C,
             'method': 'Same unchanged registered wasm-tier harness, 11 samples and symmetric 1.5xIQR. Fresh source compilation on physical Alpha for both arms. Only generated compiler_zir_lower.c/object changes; stable compiler tools relinked, all replaced bytes restored. Sequential cohorts, frequency observations observational only.'}

    def save():
        (PRIVATE / 'state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')

    def run(args):
        args = [str(v) for v in args]
        state['commands'].append(args)
        save()
        print('COMMAND', ' '.join(args), flush=True)
        subprocess.run(args, check=True)

    def cohort(arm):
        state['stage'] = arm + ' compilation and measurement'
        state['epochs'][arm] = {'compiler_sha256': hashes(TOOLS),
                                'harness_sha256': hashes(HARNESSES)}
        save()
        run([ROOT / 'build/bin/ziran', 'run', '--target=c', 'bench/bench.zi', '--',
             'wasm-tier', '--samples', '11', '--observe-host', '--label',
             'Physical Alpha signed interval lowering ' + arm, '--output', receipts[arm]])
        report = json.loads(receipts[arm].read_text())
        assert report['samples'] == 11 and report['learning'] == 'off'
        assert report['virtualization'] == 'none'
        assert set(report['kernels']) == {'Sieve', 'Records', 'Hash', 'Vectors', 'Printing'}
        for target, measured in report['kernels']['Records'].items():
            assert measured['stdout_verified'], target
            assert str(measured['result']) == '68788', (target, measured['result'])
        report['compiler_provenance'] = {
            'note': 'Compiler source checkout stays at revision; after arm overlays only the generated lowering module. See the companion state receipt for guards and complete tool hashes.',
            'epoch': arm,
            'source_lower_sha256': state['source_lower_sha256'] if arm == 'after' else sha(ROOT / 'cmd/compiler_zir_lower.zi'),
            'generated_lower_sha256': sha(ROOT / REPLACED[0]),
            'tools_sha256': hashes(TOOLS),
        }
        receipts[arm].write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        assert guards['harness'] == hashes(HARNESSES)
        assert guards['source'] == hashes(tracked)
        epoch = state['epochs'][arm]
        assert epoch['compiler_sha256'] == hashes(TOOLS)
        epoch['receipt_sha256'] = sha(receipts[arm])
        archive = PRIVATE / (arm + '-wasm-tier-artifacts.tar.gz')
        with tarfile.open(archive, 'w:gz') as bundle:
            bundle.add(ROOT / 'build/wasm-tier', arcname='build/wasm-tier')
        epoch['artifact_archive_sha256'] = sha(archive)
        save()

    originals = PRIVATE / 'originals'
    assert not originals.exists(), 'refuse to replace prior restoration material'
    originals.mkdir()
    for name in REPLACED:
        destination = originals / name
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(ROOT / name, destination)
    replaced_hashes = hashes(REPLACED)
    save()
    try:
        cohort('before')
        state['stage'] = 'install experimental lowering in stable paths'
        save()
        shutil.copy2(PRIVATE / 'compiler_zir_lower.c', ROOT / REPLACED[0])
        run(['cc', '-O2', '-Werror=frame-larger-than=16384', '-Ibuild/compiler-assembly',
             '-c', '-o', REPLACED[1], REPLACED[0]])
        objects = sorted((ROOT / 'build/obj/assembly').glob('*.o'))
        run(['cc', '-r', '-nostdlib', '-o', 'build/obj/assembly-core.o', *objects])
        for tool in ('zi2zx', 'zx2native'):
            run(['cc', '-O2', '-o', ROOT / 'build/bin' / tool,
                 ROOT / 'build/obj/cmd' / tool / 'main.o',
                 ROOT / 'build/obj/cmd/zi2zx/zx_exec_run.o',
                 ROOT / 'build/obj/assembly-core.o', ROOT / 'build/libziran.a',
                 '-lm', '-pthread', '-ldl'])
        changed_objects = tree_hashes(['build/obj/assembly'])
        assert {k:v for k,v in changed_objects.items() if k != REPLACED[1]} == {
            k:v for k,v in guards['objects'].items() if k != REPLACED[1]}
        assert sha(ROOT / REPLACED[0]) == EXPECTED_C
        cohort('after')
        state['measurement_complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        state['error'] = repr(error)
        raise
    finally:
        for name in REPLACED:
            shutil.copy2(originals / name, ROOT / name)
        state['restored'] = replaced_hashes == hashes(REPLACED)
        state['source_guard'] = guards['source'] == hashes(tracked)
        state['harness_guard'] = guards['harness'] == hashes(HARNESSES)
        state['standard_guard'] = guards['standard'] == tree_hashes(
            ['bench/standard', 'build/standard', 'bench/results/standard'])
        state['objects_guard'] = guards['objects'] == tree_hashes(['build/obj/assembly'])
        state['tools_guard'] = guards['tools'] == hashes(TOOLS)
        state['default_index_guard'] = index_before == sha(index)
        state['finished_ns'] = time.time_ns()
        state['stage'] = 'restored after measurement' if state.get('measurement_complete') else 'failed; restored'
        save()
        print('FINAL GUARDS', json.dumps({k:v for k,v in state.items() if k.endswith('_guard') or k == 'restored'}), flush=True)
        assert all(state[key] for key in ['restored', 'source_guard', 'harness_guard',
                   'standard_guard', 'objects_guard', 'tools_guard', 'default_index_guard'])
    print('FINISHED', str(PRIVATE / 'state.json'), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
